* **A pod that will not terminate is force-deleted so StatefulSet Recreate finishes in one pass.** A wedged shutdown previously aborted Recreate with the host left at `Replicas=0`. The operator now deletes that pod after a full wait timeout, emits `HostPodForceDeleted`, and completes Delete+Create in the same pass. Magda v7.1.1 fixes out-of-memory kills while indexing scanned PDFs and fixes stable releases not publishing the `latest` Docker image tag.

## What's Changed

- [#3899](https://github.com/magda-io/magda/pull/3899): Upgrade `magda-pdf-semantic-indexer` to 1.0.3, fixing OOM kills when indexing scanned PDFs.
- [#3891](https://github.com/magda-io/magda/pull/3891): Fix the release pipeline never publishing the `latest` Docker image tag for stable releases.

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/magda-io/magda/c

Magda v7.1.0 moves every Node.js-based service and module to a Node.js release with the October 2026 security fixes: [CVE-2026-111497](https://nodejs.org/en/blog/vulnerability/october-2026-security-releases) (Brotli decoder remote code execution) and the eMudhra intermediate CA compromise. It also adds opt-in WebSocket proxying to the gateway, fixes owner-scoped Storage API permissions, and fixes the compiled UI stylesheet's ordering and missing map styles.
